report: Final answer audit of MPPSC 2017 Prelims Paper-I
method: Every one of the 100 questions was re-read and answered independently; the printed key was compared with the stored answer; each explanation was rebuilt to a four-part standard (concept and justification, per-option reasoning tied to that option text, revision facts, takeaway). A correction is recorded only where the evidence contradicts the key and another option is demonstrably right; items with more than one defensible answer, an outdated fact or a contested attribution are recorded as ambiguous instead of being forced to a letter. Scan debris in option text was repaired only where the printed paper makes the intended wording certain.
